Name: Bait Count On Rod
Author: 4KMong
Description:
This is a simple mod that displays the type (as a sprite image) and the quantity of bait currently loaded on your fishing rod. It is designed to show the count even when only one bait remains. This display provides significant quality-of-life improvements, especially for controller (gamepad) users.

This mod was developed with the assistance of AI (ChatGPT, Claude) by a creator with limited coding knowledge and has been tested in a personal environment. As such, it may contain minor bugs or inefficient mechanisms for certain functions : However, based on my testing so far, it works perfectly without any performance issues—this is just my personal observation. I originally used this privately with a friend a few months back. I held off on releasing it because I wasn't sure how stable it would be, but after completing a full playthrough with no noticeable issues, I figured I'd share it publicly.

The source code is available on GitHub, and anyone is free to modify, upgrade, or redistribute it. If you create an improved version or would like to suggest a more efficient way to handle the logic, please let me know. Personally, I believe this perfectly simple version is better for user convenience than being merged into a larger, multi-feature mod.

Bug reports and ideas are always welcome, but please keep in mind that I may not be able to resolve everything depending on my technical capacity.
Thank you!
